**Quita**（`zzzbedream/quita`）**是一个**把**信用寿险**（**credit life／**seguro prestamista／**desgravamen）**的**赔付率**做成**可在链上验证**的**原型****——**逐字自述为**「**On-chain credit life insurance with a loss ratio you can verify instead of believe.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**补**覆盖薄的**业务线**」**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 接口与 README 实测）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**赔付率**」**本身**当成**要**被**验证**的**对象****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**写**「**a loss ratio you can verify instead of believe**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最值得**记**的**一句**：**⭐ 即**在**信用寿险**这个**业务线**里**，**争议**焦点**不**是**「**产品**有没有**」**，**而**是**「**收到的**保费**有**多少**真的**变成**赔付**」**——**⭐ 而**这**正好**是**一个**可以**被**披露**与**核对**的**比率**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**凡**遇到**「**行业**争议**」，**都**值得**问**一句**「**这**争议**能**不能**落成**一个**可**核算**的**比率**」**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三个**问题**被**逐字**点名**，**而**这**等于**把**社会**争议**翻译成**可**测量**的**三项****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字列出**三个**反复**出现的**抱怨**（**逐字**：**a low share of premium returned as claims**、**a large share captured as commission by the distributing bank**、**and no way for anyone outside the insurer to check either number**）**，**并逐字**指出**在**巴西**「**把**保单**与**贷款**捆绑**」**的**做法**长期**被**诉讼**（**逐字**：**the practice of tying the policy to the loan has been the subject of sustained litigation**）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**这一处**值得**单独**记**：**⭐ 即**「**赔付率**低」**与**「**佣金**占比**高」**与**「**外部**无法**核对**」**是**三件**不同的**事**，**而**它们**需要**不同的**解法**（**前者**属**产品**设计**、**中者**属**渠道**结构**、**后者**属**披露**与**可验证性）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**把**抱怨**拆**成**可**分别**处理**的三项**，**是**提出**可**落地**方案的**前提**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 市场**数字**被**作者**自己**标注**为**待**核对**（**⭐ 本轮**最**值得**学的**一处**诚实**）**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**写**「**Market figures cited in the deck are drawn from analysis of the Tema 972 litigation and industry commentary, and are pending cross-check against public SUSEP statistics.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**不**引用**其**任何**市场**数字**，**并**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**引用**了**诉讼**分析**与**行业**评论**」**与**「**已**与**监管**统计**核对**」**是**两件**事**——**⭐ 而**作者**把**这**一层**差距**写在**文档**里**，**这**比**多数**作品**的**处理**方式**更**可信**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**的**简报**里有**来自**二手**评论**的数字**，**就**应**像**这样**标注**它**尚未**与**官方**统计**对账**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 交付**形态**是**竞赛**作品**，**而**这**决定**它**的**成熟度**边界****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README 逐字**写**「**Built for BUIDL CTC 2026 Fall · Track: RWA · Powered by the Attestcoin Protocol**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**它是**一个**赛道**作品**（**RWA** 即**真实世界资产**方向）**，**而**不**是**已**上线**的**保险**产品**——**⭐ 判断**这类**项目**时**要**看**「**它**解决**了**哪一步**的**可验证性**」**，**而**不**是**看**它**是否**已**能**承保**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[susep-open-insurance]] 与 **[[monitora-tiss]] 覆盖**巴西**监管**侧**的**开放**数据**、**[[condition-parametric-zk]] 与 **[[payout-assurance-standard]] 覆盖**链上**赔付**与**证明**、**[[ensuro]] 与 **[[etherisc-gif]] 覆盖**链上**保险**平台****——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**可验证**赔付率**为**卖点**的**信用寿险**原型**」这一**形态**（**⭐ 且**它**的**三个**问题**清单**可**当作**该**业务线**的**分析**框架**）**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**行业**争议**落**成**可**核算**的**比率**；**② **把**抱怨**拆**成**可**分别**处理**的**几项**；**③ **二手**数字**要**标注**是否**已**与**官方**统计**对账**；**④ **竞赛**作品**要看**它**解决**了**哪一步**，**而**不**是**看**它**是否**已**承保**；**⑤ **渠道**佣金**与**赔付**占比**属**不同**问题**，**不要**混**成**一个**道德**判断**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有运行**其**任何**合约**或**前端**（**未**编译 **TypeScript**、**未**连接**任何**链、**未**验证**任何**赔付率**）**，**故**不主张**其**可验证性**真的**成立**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**仓库接口返回的元数据**与 **README 文本**，**未读**其**合约**与**前端**源码**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**引用的**三个**问题**在**巴西**的实际**程度**（**⭐ 本词条**不**引用**其**任何**市场**数字**，**因**其**逐字**标注**为**待**核对**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与 **Attestcoin** 或**任何**链**的**技术**依赖**是否**可**长期**使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**涉及**任何**持牌**主体**或**监管**要求**（**⭐ 信用寿险**在**多数**辖区**属**受**监管**业务）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 该仓库**无许可证文件**（**接口 `license` 字段为空**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该原型**是**竞赛**作品**，**不**是**保险产品**，**也**不**是**投保或**投资建议**。

**Quita**（`zzzbedream/quita`）**是一個**把**信用壽險**（**credit life／**seguro prestamista／**desgravamen）**的**賠付率**做成**可在鏈上驗證**的**原型****——**逐字自述為**「**On-chain credit life insurance with a loss ratio you can verify instead of believe.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**補覆蓋薄的業務線**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 GitHub 介面與 README 實測）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把「**賠付率**」本身當成要被驗證的對象****——**逐字**a loss ratio you can verify instead of believe**；**⭐ 即**這個業務線的爭議焦點不是「**產品有沒有**」**，**而是「**收到的保費有多少真的變成賠付**」**。

**⭐⭐ ② 三個問題被逐字點名****——**逐字**a low share of premium returned as claims**、**a large share captured as commission by the distributing bank**、**and no way for anyone outside the insurer to check either number**，**並逐字指出巴西**把保單與貸款捆綁**長期被訴訟（**逐字**the practice of tying the policy to the loan has been the subject of sustained litigation**）**；**⭐ 即**三件事需要三種解法（**產品設計、**渠道結構、**披露與可驗證性）**。

**⭐⭐ ③ 市場數字由作者自己標註為待核對****——**逐字**Market figures cited in the deck are drawn from analysis of the Tema 972 litigation and industry commentary, and are pending cross-check against public SUSEP statistics.**；**⭐ 本條據此不引用其任何市場數字**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 交付形態是競賽作品****——**逐字**Built for BUIDL CTC 2026 Fall · Track: RWA · Powered by the Attestcoin Protocol**；**⭐ 即**判斷這類項目要看它**解決了哪一步的可驗證性**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[susep-open-insurance]]、[[monitora-tiss]]、[[condition-parametric-zk]]、[[payout-assurance-standard]]、[[ensuro]]、[[etherisc-gif]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**以可驗證賠付率為賣點的信用壽險原型**」**這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **爭議落成可核算比率**；**② **抱怨拆成可分別處理的幾項**；**③ **二手數字標註是否已對賬**；**④ **競賽作品看它解決了哪一步**；**⑤ **佣金與賠付占比不要混成道德判斷**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有運行**其任何合約或前端**，**不主張**其可驗證性真的成立**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀元資料與 README 文本**，**未讀**其合約與前端源碼**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其引用的三個問題在巴西的實際程度**（**不引用**其任何市場數字**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其與 Attestcoin 或任何鏈的技術依賴是否可長期使用**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其是否涉及任何持牌主體或監管要求**。**⑥ ⚠️ 該倉庫無許可證檔案**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-12 所見**；**⚠️ 該原型是競賽作品**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**投保或投資建議**。
e.body_en:
This is a prototype that turns the loss ratio of credit life insurance into something verifiable on a public ledger, stating in writing that it offers a loss ratio you can verify rather than believe. **This entry belongs to the round theme of filling thin lines of business.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the repository interface and the description**:

**First, the loss ratio itself is treated as the object to be verified.** The description frames the product as having a loss ratio that can be verified rather than believed. **In this line the dispute is not whether the product exists but how much of the premium actually returns as claims, and that is exactly the kind of quantity that can be disclosed and reconciled, so whenever an industry controversy appears it is worth asking whether it can be reduced to a checkable ratio.**

**Second, three problems are named in writing, which translates a social controversy into three measurable items.** The description lists a low share of premium returned as claims, a large share captured as commission by the distributing bank, and no way for anyone outside the insurer to check either number, and notes that in Brazil the practice of tying the policy to the loan has been the subject of sustained litigation. **A low payout share, a high distribution commission, and an absence of external verification are three different problems requiring three different remedies, in product design, channel structure, and disclosure respectively, and separating a complaint into separately addressable items is the precondition for proposing anything workable.**

**Third, the market figures are marked by the author as awaiting reconciliation.** The description states that the deck figures come from analysis of litigation and industry commentary and are pending cross-check against the supervisor public statistics, so this entry cites none of them. **Citing secondary commentary and having reconciled with official statistics are two different things, and stating that gap in the document is more credible than the usual treatment, so any briefing that uses second-hand numbers should say whether they have been reconciled.**

**Fourth, the delivery form is a competition entry, which sets the boundary of its maturity.** The description names the programme, the real-world-asset track, and the attestation protocol behind it. **For projects of this kind the question is which step of verifiability they solved, not whether they can already underwrite.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the Brazilian regulator open data and health-data standard, on-chain payout proof and standards, and on-chain insurance platforms, **while this entry supplies the form of a credit life prototype whose selling point is a verifiable loss ratio, and whose list of three problems can serve as an analysis frame for that line. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: reduce a controversy to a checkable ratio; split a complaint into separately addressable items; mark whether second-hand numbers have been reconciled; judge a competition prototype by which step it solved; and keep commission and payout share as separate questions rather than merging them into one moral judgement.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no contract and no front end was run**, nothing was compiled, no chain was contacted, and no loss ratio was verified, **so no claim is made that the verifiability works**. **Second, only repository metadata and the description were read**, not the contract or front-end source. **Third, the real extent of the three problems in that market was not verified**, and this entry cites none of the market figures because the author marks them as awaiting reconciliation. **Fourth, whether its dependency on the named attestation protocol is sustainable was not verified. Fifth, whether it involves any licensed entity or regulatory requirement was not verified**, credit life being a regulated line in most jurisdictions. **Sixth, the repository carries no licence file. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-12 and states plainly that the prototype is a competition entry rather than an insurance product or a purchase or investment recommendation.**
